Professional Summary: Generative AI Technical Architect with 10+ years of experience leading the design and deployment of LLM- driven enterprise solutions across finance, aerospace, and defense. PROJECTS:

Project Name: RappidX– GenAI-Powered Legacy Modernization Duration: August 2024 – Present Role: Generative AI Technical Architect & Program Lead Responsibilities: • Spearheading a high-impact AI modernization initiative aimed at transforming legacy enterprise systems into an intelligent, LLM-native architecture using LangChain, LangGraph, and Graph-RAG pipelines.

Architected an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework with support for Knowledge-Augmented Generation (KAG) and Agentic RAG to convert unstructured business documentation into executable Python code and microservices.

Designed a scalable Multi-Agent System (MAS) leveraging Toolformer-style agents and Autonomous AI Systems to autonomously interpret, refactor, and generate new business logic code from legacy codebases.

Led the end-to-end development strategy using LLMOps best practices, integrating Prompt Engineering, RAG Fusion, and Vector Databases (FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone) for document chunking, semantic retrieval, and long-context reasoning.

Provided architectural direction for GenAI pipelines embedded with real-time decision-making capabilities across financial, compliance, and operational workflows.

Oversaw a cross-functional team of 45+ AI/ML engineers, architects, and DevOps professionals, mentoring them on GenAI methodologies, performance tuning, and best practices in AI system design. • Built a modular GenAI SDK with internal APIs and toolchains to streamline integration across services,

optimizing for scalability, accuracy, and latency.

Championed the development of LLM-powered business logic reconstruction models, replacing brittle rule-based engines with context-aware, auto-evolving AI code generators.

Evangelized GenAI adoption across leadership and engineering teams, helping align AI strategy with long-term business transformation goals.

Utilized Docker, Redis, and PyCharm for local DevOps workflows, and deployed AI agents on microservice-based environments for fast iteration and scalability.

Project Name: BlackRock USA – AI-Driven Portfolio Risk & Reporting Platform Duration: June 2022 – August 2024 Role: Deep Learning Engineer Project Objective: To developed GenAI-driven platform to automate portfolio risk assessment, investment insight generation, and institutional financial reporting system using custom Large Language Model (BlackRock-FinLLM).

Responsibilities:

• Designed and developed BlackRock-FinLLM, a domain-specific LLM fine-tuned on institutional financial

data, including fund performance reports, market trends, and macroeconomic indicators.

Designed and developed BlackRock-FinLLM, a domain-specific LLM fine-tuned on institutional financial data, including fund performance reports, market trends, and macroeconomic indicators.

Built AI-powered portfolio risk evaluation modules leveraging transformer models (BERT, Falcon, LLaMA, GPT-NeoX) to identify exposure anomalies, liquidity risks, and asset correlations.

Engineered data ingestion and pretraining pipelines that processed millions of financial records from



internal databases, regulatory disclosures, and real-time market feeds for model training. Implemented RAG-based reporting automation, combining LangChain, LlamaIndex, and FAISS to enable LLMs to generate context-aware financial summaries and compliance-ready reports.

Developed LLM inference microservices using FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and deployed on AWS Sagemaker for scalable real-time portfolio intelligence delivery.

Created prompt-engineered templates for automated generation of quarterly fund commentaries, risk summaries, and performance dashboards with verifiable audit trails.

Applied parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT) and quantization techniques to improve LLM throughput and cost efficiency in production environments.

Collaborated with quantitative risk teams and compliance analysts to ensure model outputs align with financial governance, audit transparency, and institutional reporting standards.

Established continuous model evaluation pipelines using MLflow for tracking report accuracy, risk detection metrics, and language model drift.

Tools & Technologies: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, FAISS, Docker, AWS Sagemaker, EC2, MLflow, Pandas, NumPy, LoRA, PEFT, GitHub

Project Name: INCRED Financial Services Ltd (FLDG Partnership) Duration: June 2021 – Aug 2022 Role: Senior Software Engineer (Applied AI & Backend Research) Project Objective: To automate the personal loan origination process by integrating AI-driven credit evaluation, document understanding, and risk profiling using transformer-based NLP and backend microservices. Responsibilities: • Led R&D and backend development to automate personal loan applications, integrating credit bureaus

(CIBIL, Equifax, Experian) for real-time borrower credit evaluation.

Fetching credit information from different credit beuro (CIBIL, EQUIFAX and Experian) and analysis and assessing reports using PreTrained Distil-BERT model.

Designed and fine-tuned BERT Base and DistilBERT models to extract and classify key financial entities (income, liabilities, PAN/Aadhaar data) from user-submitted documents.

Built a document intelligence pipeline combining Google OCR, BERT embeddings, and semantic similarity models for loan processing(Loan amount and Eligibility calculating).

Developed AI-driven creditworthiness scoring models and decision trees for FLDG lending risk assessment, enhancing underwriting precision.

Experimented with GPT-2 and T5 for text summarization and synthetic data generation to augment limited labeled datasets in loan application scenarios.

Created scalable RESTful microservices using Python (Django REST Framework) to orchestrate document parsing, NLP inference, and credit scoring workflows.

Conducted research on transformer explainability and feature attribution to ensure compliance with financial transparency regulations.

Deployed and optimized AI models on AWS EC2 and Lambda, reducing response latency by over 40% for real-time credit assessments.

Collaborated with cross-functional data and credit teams to align ML model outcomes with business rules and improve loan approval accuracy.

Tools & Technologies: Python, Django REST Framework, BERT Base, DistilBERT, GPT-2, T5, Hugging Face Transformers, AWS EC2, Lambda, Google OCR, Pandas, NumPy, Postman, GitHub

Project Name: AIRBUS – Aircraft Maintenance Management System Duration: September 2020 – April 2021 Role: Senior Software Engineer – Aircraft Maintenance Responsibilities:





fine-tuned custom BERT architectures using PyTorch to extract structured information from aircraft manuals, maintenance logs, and technical bulletins. Implemented domain-specific tokenization and embeddings, adapting BERT to understand aerospace terminology, component codes, and maintenance procedures.

Designed multi-task BERT models capable of entity recognition, document classification, and semantic similarity scoring, increasing processing speed and accuracy.

Built deep learning pipelines for preprocessing millions of unstructured aviation records, including data cleaning, tokenization, and embedding generation for model training and inference.

Applied attention visualization and interpretability techniques to analyze BERT predictions and highlight critical maintenance risk factors.

Developed predictive maintenance modules combining BERT embeddings with historical sensor and performance data to anticipate potential component failures.

Engineered semantic search and retrieval systems using FAISS to allow natural language queries over large volumes of technical documents.

Built backend inference microservices with FastAPI and containerized them using Docker, enabling scalable AI-powered insights for engineering teams.

Applied LoRA and PEFT fine-tuning for efficient adaptation of BERT models to domain-specific aerospace data.

Tools & Technologies: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, FastAPI, Docker, FAISS, Pandas, NumPy, LoRA, PEFT

Project Name: BAE Systems – Sensor Integration & Signal Processing Platform Duration: February 2019 – May 2020 Role: Full Stack Developer – Defense Systems

Responsibilities:

Developed backend modules in Python to manage real-time data flow from onboard sensors,



including data collection, formatting, and signal handling. Implemented communication scripts to interface between system hardware and I/O ports, enabling secure transmission to radio-frequency (RF) devices.

Created Python-based REST APIs to transmit processed sensor data to MATLAB for further signal analysis and simulation.

Authored mathematical scripting components for equation-based signal processing within mission- critical modules.

Designed interactive data visualizations using Angular 9, including real-time plotting of signal outputs and telemetry data.

Built component-driven SPA (Single Page Applications) using Angular 9 and TypeScript for dynamic



dashboards and control interfaces. Implemented reusable data formatting (pipes) and logic-driven UI controls (structural directives) to ensure secure and consistent frontend display.

Designed responsive frontend layouts using HTML5, Bootstrap, and custom CSS for both desktop and mission console environments.

Collaborated on a side module to expose APIs to a React Native application designed for remote signal diagnostics and control. Tools & Technologies: Python, REST API, Angular 9, TypeScript, React Native, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Postman

Project Name: Lufthansa Airlines – Flight Operations & Crew Management Duration: September 2017 – December 2018 Role: Backend Engineer Responsibilities: • Developed RESTful APIs using Django REST Framework to manage core backend services, including

crew assignment, flight scheduling, and operational tracking.

Designed and built internal desktop tools with Tkinter and TtkBootstrap for operations support and



real-time crew status management. Implemented Python-based business logic for manipulating operational data, integrating itseamlessly with backend APIs.

Created modular and reusable backend modules to support workflow automation and crew management processes.

Developed Python-based logic to manipulate operational data and connected backend APIs with



frontend interfaces. Integrated and tested modules using Postman, version-controlled in Git, and CI/CD managed through Jenkins.

Ensured data integrity, validation, and logging for operational-critical backend systems.

Tech Stack: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Tkinter, TtkBootstrap, Postman, Git, Jenkins

Project Name: SCB Bank Ltd – Digital Lending & Gold Loan Platform Duration: February 2016 – November 2017 Role: Backend & API Developer Responsibilities: • Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Django REST Framework for customer onboarding,



Aadhaar and PAN-based KYC verification, credit checks, and loan disbursement workflows. Implemented backend logic for integrations with SMS gateways, Microsoft Authenticator (2FA), and NACH e-mandates to automate secure customer verification.

Built microservices using Express.js to fetch and process credit bureau data (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF) and verify PAN via government APIs.

Designed auto credit approval mechanisms leveraging user credit profiles and gold loan valuation signals..

Managed relational and NoSQL databases using MySQL and AWS DynamoDB for transactional and operational data storage.

Developed internal backend modules for accounting dashboards, access control, and workflow automation for bank manager.

Conducted API testing and validation using Postman, maintained version control with Git, and supported CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins. Tech Stack: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, DynamoDB, Postman, Git, Jenkins

Bachelor of Technology in Electronics Engineering, UVCE-Bengaluru University, KA-India

Diploma In Electronics Engineering, SRVR Polytechnic 2009-2013

High school from GNS High school ,2009

Successful Business Tie up with TTH, Kolkata

Employee Of the Year 2019

Active participant in Hackathons and Competitive Coding Contests, contributing innovative solutions to real-world tech challenges.

Supporter and contributor to Open Source Communities with a focus on developer tools, backend systems, and GenAI utilities.

Passionate about Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking, with hands-on experience in vulnerability assessment and secure coding practices.

Contributor to Open Source Cybersecurity Projects, focusing on secure API design, threat modeling, and data protection strategies.

Project Name: RappidX– GenAI-Powered Legacy Modernization Duration: August 2024 – Present Role: Generative AI Technical Architect & Program Lead Responsibilities: • Spearheading a high-impact AI modernization initiative aimed at transforming legacy enterprise systems into an intelligent, LLM-native architecture using LangChain, LangGraph, and Graph-RAG pipelines.
Architected an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework with support for Knowledge-Augmented Generation (KAG) and Agentic RAG to convert unstructured business documentation into executable Python code and microservices.
Designed a scalable Multi-Agent System (MAS) leveraging Toolformer-style agents and Autonomous AI Systems to autonomously interpret, refactor, and generate new business logic code from legacy codebases.
Led the end-to-end development strategy using LLMOps best practices, integrating Prompt Engineering, RAG Fusion, and Vector Databases (FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone) for document chunking, semantic retrieval, and long-context reasoning.
Provided architectural direction for GenAI pipelines embedded with real-time decision-making capabilities across financial, compliance, and operational workflows.
Oversaw a cross-functional team of 45+ AI/ML engineers, architects, and DevOps professionals, mentoring them on GenAI methodologies, performance tuning, and best practices in AI system design. • Built a modular GenAI SDK with internal APIs and toolchains to streamline integration across services,
optimizing for scalability, accuracy, and latency.
Championed the development of LLM-powered business logic reconstruction models, replacing brittle rule-based engines with context-aware, auto-evolving AI code generators.
Evangelized GenAI adoption across leadership and engineering teams, helping align AI strategy with long-term business transformation goals.
Utilized Docker, Redis, and PyCharm for local DevOps workflows, and deployed AI agents on microservice-based environments for fast iteration and scalability.
Project Name: BlackRock USA – AI-Driven Portfolio Risk & Reporting Platform Duration: June 2022 – August 2024 Role: Deep Learning Engineer Project Objective: To developed GenAI-driven platform to automate portfolio risk assessment, investment insight generation, and institutional financial reporting system using custom Large Language Model (BlackRock-FinLLM).
Responsibilities:
• Designed and developed BlackRock-FinLLM, a domain-specific LLM fine-tuned on institutional financial
data, including fund performance reports, market trends, and macroeconomic indicators.
Designed and developed BlackRock-FinLLM, a domain-specific LLM fine-tuned on institutional financial data, including fund performance reports, market trends, and macroeconomic indicators.
Built AI-powered portfolio risk evaluation modules leveraging transformer models (BERT, Falcon, LLaMA, GPT-NeoX) to identify exposure anomalies, liquidity risks, and asset correlations.
Engineered data ingestion and pretraining pipelines that processed millions of financial records from

internal databases, regulatory disclosures, and real-time market feeds for model training. Implemented RAG-based reporting automation, combining LangChain, LlamaIndex, and FAISS to enable LLMs to generate context-aware financial summaries and compliance-ready reports.
Developed LLM inference microservices using FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and deployed on AWS Sagemaker for scalable real-time portfolio intelligence delivery.
Created prompt-engineered templates for automated generation of quarterly fund commentaries, risk summaries, and performance dashboards with verifiable audit trails.
Applied parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT) and quantization techniques to improve LLM throughput and cost efficiency in production environments.
Collaborated with quantitative risk teams and compliance analysts to ensure model outputs align with financial governance, audit transparency, and institutional reporting standards.
Established continuous model evaluation pipelines using MLflow for tracking report accuracy, risk detection metrics, and language model drift.
